node.statement: Uniform threshold and amplified delta-projections: there is a universal e_cmp>0 such that, if e=delta+epsilon<=e_cmp, then for every n>=1 the elements P_n=I_n tensor P and Q_n=I_n tensor Q are delta-projections in the epsilon-C*-algebra M_n tensor A and the theta power series defining both Co_{P,Q} and Co_{P_n,Q_n} is in its convergence domain.
